cohort: The study enrolled two hundred preterm pregnant women aged 21 to 44 years, based on clinical diagnosis.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids, caesarean section, cardiotocograph monitoring, vaginal progesterone, Kangaroo Mother Care, continuous positive airway pressure, magnesium sulfate, and delayed clamping were associated with significant positive outcomes for preterm infants.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to bring positive outcomes in preterm delivery.
